letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Senior Software Engineer role with Example Hiring Team. My background aligns closely with your need for reliable services, recovery tests, and OpenTelemetry tracing. Across API and data-platform work, I focus on observable behavior, deliberate failure handling, and clear operational documentation.

At Example Systems, I designed a PostgreSQL-backed job queue with idempotent workers and recovery tests for interrupted tasks. I also introduced OpenTelemetry traces across API and worker boundaries, helping on-call engineers isolate slow requests. I led design reviews for a staged move from synchronous processing to background jobs, documented rollback criteria, and mentored engineers through incident reviews and regression testing for duplicate delivery and partial failure.

Alongside my professional work, I built Queue Observatory, a workload simulator that reproduces worker crashes and compares retry policies, with runnable tests and design notes covering idempotency-key expiry and recovery verification.

Previously, at Sample Cloud, I implemented versioned Node.js APIs and contract tests that kept customer integrations working through releases. After profiling production-like workloads, I reworked database queries and verified query plans before adding indexes. I also built an accessible React console for reviewing failed jobs and retrying only affected work. These experiences strengthened my ability to connect service reliability with practical operational tooling.

I would bring a hands-on engineering perspective, careful attention to recovery behavior, and a collaborative approach to design and incident review. The role is a strong match for the work I most value: building dependable systems, making failures diagnosable, and supporting engineers through delivery. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how this experience could contribute to your team.

Kind regards,
Renée Ionescu
